newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Finansbank signs $25 mln one-yr loan.
newsitem.headline: Finansbank signs $25 mln one-yr loan.

text.p: Turkish investment bank Finansbank on Tuesday signed in Bahrain a $25 million one-year pre-export loan facility with a number of financial institutions, arranger Gulf International Bank (GIB) said.
The facility was jointly arranged by The Arab Investment Co (TAIC) and GIB, it said in a statement.

The other participants are Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait BSC, Al-Ahli Commercial Bank BSC, majority Dubai-owned Emirates Bank International, London Forfaiting Co, Misr International Bank SAE and Grindlays Bahrain Bank BSC.
The facility, priced at one percent over LIBOR, will be used by Finansbank to refinance its pre-export loans to Turkish exporters, the statement said.
GIB is wholly owned by the Kuwait-based Gulf Investment Corp which in turn is owned by the governments of Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.
TAIC is owned by a number of Arab states.
